references.text: Kittim is mentioned as a descendant of Javan and refers to the coasts and islands of the Mediterranean Sea, especially Cyprus and the regions westward.
Isaiah prophesies about ships from Kittim bringing news of Tyre's fall, pointing to maritime powers from the west.
Kittim is mentioned again in connection with Tyre and seafaring from western regions.
Jeremiah prophesies about destruction coming from the ends of the earth, parallel to the judgment against Asshur and Eber.
Ezekiel mentions Kittim as a supplier of cedar wood for Tyre's ships, confirming the link to western maritime powers.
Daniel prophesies about ships from Kittim coming against the king of the north, a direct parallel to Balaam's prophecy.
Eber is mentioned as the ancestor of the Hebrews, and his descendants will also be afflicted according to the prophecy.
Asshur is mentioned as a son of Shem and the ancestor of the Assyrians, who according to the prophecy will be afflicted.
